projects.name: Alinia

projects.attribution: Team delivery with Tayseer Laz and Aligned Tech; Layth's evidenced contribution spans the application, backend, AI and search behavior, access boundaries, workflows, Hader integration, deployment, and production fixes.

projects.name: OmniSign
projects.summary: Lebanese Sign Language recognition across isolated signs and bounded temporal sequences, built with community-collected data; it is not unrestricted continuous translation.
projects.attribution: Team project; Layth led collection strategy, processing, augmentation, landmark extraction, training and evaluation, combined-model integration, and connection of inference to the application.

projects.name: Lancaster Hospitality Platform
projects.summary: Independent property websites sharing an engineering foundation while preserving each hotel's public identity, workflows, and release boundary.
projects.attribution: Built, deployed, operated, and maintained by Layth Ayache and Tayseer Laz.

projects.name: Bridge
projects.summary: Independent systems for Achour Holding and Aligned Tech that turn upstream operational records into scoped, traceable views; they do not share a database or deployment.
projects.attribution: Layth architected and implemented Bridge at Achour Holding end to end; it is adopted by the development department and subsidiaries. Bridge at Aligned Tech was shared work with Tayseer Laz and the internal team and is the company's main CEO operations dashboard.

projects.name: PrivacyGuard
